title: Catholic Computer signatures
description: Signatures in personal support of the Catholic Computer principles. A signature is a personal endorsement only, and is not an endorsement by any diocese, order, parish, or the Holy See.

updated.description: Date this file was last edited (ISO 8601).

name.description: Name the signer chose to be shown; may be initials or a nickname.

title.description: Optional title, e.g. for clergy and religious. Shown as a personal endorsement only.
